## Description {#details}

<p>By default, this delegates all calls to the underlying file system.</p>


<p>This is useful when derived file systems want to override some calls and still proxy other calls.</p>


<p>Definition at line 451 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/support/virtualfilesystem-h">VirtualFileSystem.h</a>.</p>
